findings.evidence: FiniteField.lean:47 `simpa [qPowerFrobenius_eq_iterated] using qPowerFrobenius_over k (𝟙 _) a ha` and lines 63-64 (identical); Iterate.lean:204-211 `suffices (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).iterateFrobenius p (natCast_spec_eq_zero (CommRingCat.of k)) a = 𝟙 _ by ...`. A grep of TauCeti for `iterateFrobenius.*= 𝟙` finds no named lemma for this, only `iterateFrobenius_zero` (Iterate.lean:59).
findings.fix: In `Iterate.lean`, turn that `suffices` into a public lemma, for example `Spec_iterateFrobenius_eq_id (k) [Finite k] (ha : Nat.card k = p ^ a) : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).iterateFrobenius p (natCast_spec_eq_zero _) a = 𝟙 _`, proved with `Spec_map_iterateFrobenius`, `iterateFrobenius_eq_pow` and `FiniteField.frobenius_pow`. Then use it in `qPowerFrobenius_over`, in the `congrHom` argument of `qPowerFrobeniusTwistIso`, and in `qPowerFrobeniusTwistIso_hom_comp` (`rw [qPowerFrobeniusTwistIso_hom, pullback.condition, Spec_iterateFrobenius_eq_id, Category.comp_id]`).
findings.issue: The proof that `(Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).iterateFrobenius p _ a = 𝟙 _` (via `simpa [qPowerFrobenius_eq_iterated] using qPowerFrobenius_over k (𝟙 _) a ha`) appears twice: inline in `qPowerFrobeniusTwistIso` (line 47) and as `hF` in `qPowerFrobeniusTwistIso_hom_comp` (lines 63-64). The example file re-derives it a third time (`have h` for `ZMod 2`). The same fact is already proved inside `qPowerFrobenius_over` (`Iterate.lean:204-211`), but only as a local `suffices`, so nothing else can use it.

findings.evidence: Twist.lean:116-118 `noncomputable def iterateFrobeniusTwistZeroIso : pullback π (S.iterateFrobenius p hS 0) ≅ X := pullback.congrHom rfl (iterateFrobenius_zero hS) ≪≫ asIso (pullback.fst π (𝟙 S))`, compared with FiniteField.lean:46-48.
findings.fix: Define it as `pullback.congrHom rfl ((Spec_iterateFrobenius_eq_id ..).trans (iterateFrobenius_zero _).symm) ≪≫ f.iterateFrobeniusTwistZeroIso p (natCast_spec_eq_zero _)`. Then `qPowerFrobeniusTwistIso_hom` follows from `iterateFrobeniusTwistZeroIso_hom`.
findings.issue: `qPowerFrobeniusTwistIso` copies the body of the existing `iterateFrobeniusTwistZeroIso` (`pullback.congrHom rfl _ ≪≫ asIso (pullback.fst π (𝟙 S))`); only the equality proof passed to `congrHom` differs.

summary: The finite-field twist identification and base-change formula are new and reuse the existing twist pullback square, `IsPullback.of_iso`/`isoPullback` and `qPowerFrobenius_over`. One fact, that the a-fold Frobenius of `Spec k` is the identity, is re-derived in two places in the diff and again inside `qPowerFrobenius_over`; it should be a single named lemma.
